title: Trauma-Informed Yoga Class for Survivors (November)
description: A safe space for survivors of sexual violence to experience the healing benefits of Yoga. Led by Dana Perry Kirchoff, E-RYT. Hosted by CRCC.
long_description:
A safe space for survivors of sexual violence to experience the healing benefits of Yoga. Led by Dana Perry Kirchoff, E-RYT. Hosted by CRCC.

About this Event

Cleveland Rape Crisis Center invites survivors of rape and sexual abuse to a free community yoga class. This class is designed to be a safe space for survivors to experience the healing benefits of Yoga. This practice will allow students an opportunity to increase body awareness in support of greater physical, emotional and mental well being.
We will explore breathing practices and therapeutic movement to help survivors in connecting mindfully to the moment. We will learn ways to listen to our bodies and breath so we can honor our own unique experience and needs.

Who can attend?
Survivors of sexual violence/sexual trauma.All yoga experience levels welcome.All genders welcome.Survivors ages 13-17 may attend if accompanied by a parent/guardian. Please register the adult and child separately.

About Dana:
Dana has been practicing and teaching yoga for 20 years. She has trained in a variety of modalities and has learned from many amazing teachers over the years. Her most recent work has been focused on teaching yoga + mindfulness to kids ages K-8, as well as providing Trauma Informed Yoga classes for the community.
“I am deeply committed to this path and am grateful for the opportunity to share all the beautiful healing benefits these practices can provide. Along with my work in schools and as a trauma informed yoga teacher, I am also a mother and musician. I am passionate about creating communities that can support and uplift us all.”
